column2: Viper .22
A two-shot over-under derringer chambered in .22 SR, 3D printed in plastic.
Small enough to hide in a palm. Two barrels, two chances; after that, run.
Blunderpipe
A sawn-off double-barrel 12 gauge shotgun, with a dark red grip and forend.
Cut down well past what Security tolerates. In the Lower Levels, it settles arguments at point-blank range.
Sentinel 10
A machine pistol chambered in 10mm, in polymer and steel, with its magazine in front of the trigger.
A design older than the station, brought up to date by Lower Level gunsmiths.
Hornet
A personal defense weapon chambered in .22 SR, 3D printed in plastic, with a top-mounted magazine and a folding stock.
Comes out of the printer in one piece. A bit of sanding and it is ready to sell.
Pile Driver
A long-barrel revolver chambered in .45 AFP, with a wooden grip. Huge power, brutal recoil.
Six shots. Most customers buy it for the noise.
Longsight
A bullpup carbine chambered in 10mm, with a built-in scope and the magazine behind the grip.
A long barrel in a compact gun. The most accurate weapon Vex has ever hung on her board.
Aurora
A gold-plated revolver chambered in 10mm, with a pearl grip.
A collector's piece no chip can print. Only ever found in sealed crates, and nobody knows who fills them.
Malorian Arms 3516
A custom-made power pistol chambered in 10mm: chrome slide, black frame, skeletonized red grip.
One of a kind. It belonged to a rockerboy who hated the corps; word is it hits even harder than he sang.
Crucible
An energy sword with a red, rune-etched blade, a medallion guard and a T-shaped tip.
One of a kind. Its last owner never said a word: he would rip and tear, until it was done.
Holographic Sight
A holographic sight that projects a teal reticle for quick target acquisition.
2x Scope
A 2x magnifying scope for the rail. Very accurate, but bulky.
Muzzle Brake
A muzzle device that vents escaping gases to reduce recoil.
Heavy Suppressor
A long, heavy multi-caliber suppressor that reduces the noise of gunfire and steadies the muzzle.
Angled Grip
An angled foregrip for long guns, designed to improve handling.
Tactical Light
An underbarrel light that lights up the target, improving aim in the dark.
Extended 10mm Magazine
An extended polymer 10mm magazine for magazine-fed 10mm guns.
Folding Stock
A folding steel stock compatible with long guns, designed to improve recoil handling.
Polished Slide
A mirror finish for the slide. Purely cosmetic. Pistols and the Hornet only. Cannot be combined with Gold Inlay.
Match Trigger
A trigger tuned to the gram that reduces pull weight and improves accuracy.
Gold Inlay
Gold threads inlaid in the metal. Spectacular. Cannot be combined with Polished Slide.
Reinforced Frame
Steel reinforcements for the frame that improve resistance to failure under stress.
Overpressure Kit
Reworked springs and chamber for hotter loads. More stopping power, at the cost of wear.
Bayonet
A steel blade that clips under the muzzle of long guns. Adds stopping power and style, but weighs the muzzle down. Also sells as a melee weapon.
Reloaded .22 Ammunition
A handful of .22 SR rounds, reloaded by hand from salvaged casings. Cheaper, and almost as good.
Reloaded 10mm Ammunition
A handful of 10mm rounds, reloaded in Vex's back room. Every round has its little quirk.
10mm Steel-Core Ammunition
A handful of 10mm rounds with hardened steel tips. Armor-piercing, and very illegal.

A sealed crate with no label. Holds 4 to 6 .22 or 10mm rounds.

Gunsmith's Manual
A handy manual that contains all the information on Vex's contracts, gun permits and gun printing.
Gunsmith's Manual
Vex and her Contracts
Vex visits your Store on day 3, then opens her armory at night. Her contracts are sold in the network.
Contract I (250): the Viper and precision attachments.
Contract II (500): Sentinel, Blunderpipe, metal and CNC modules.
Contract III (800): Hornet, Pile Driver, Longsight.
A contract only counts while you are covered for its rank.

A permit, or one of Vex's cats, in the display case brings gun buyers.

First Days
3 spools of filament print a Viper worth 120: sell it, print another.
Vex's buyers pay 25% more. Clandestine start: two come on days 3 and 5; her line (8390) sends more.
The Gun Tinkerer buys loose attachments: keep 2 unmounted, or one in the display case.

From day 4, a buyer may order a gun built: 25% down and a Gun Order Slip, back in 3 days.
Put your first credits back into chips: they pay for themselves in a few nights.
